title: Order details with customer names
prompt: Return the order id, customer name, and amount for every order (inner join orders with customers).
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE cust (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT); INSERT INTO cust VALUES (1,'Alice'),(2,'Bob'),(3,'Carol'); CREATE TABLE ord (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, cust_id INTEGER, amount REAL); INSERT INTO ord VALUES (1,1,50.0),(2,2,30.0),(3,1,20.0),(4,3,75.0);
reference_sql: SELECT ord.id, cust.name, ord.amount FROM ord JOIN cust ON ord.cust_id = cust.id;
